How booking works

Four simple steps.

  1. Book a free First Step Call or ask for a training quote.
  2. CJ confirms fit and availability.
  3. CJ sends payment details privately. Malaysia: bank transfer or DuitNow QR. Singapore and other countries: Wise.
  4. CJ confirms your booking in writing.

APC provides parent and educator education, prioritisation, planning, implementation support, review and adjustment. APC does not provide diagnosis, therapy, medical treatment, crisis work, unlimited messaging or guaranteed outcomes.
